A [[Kanaxai's Chest]] will spawn in [[The Deep]], nearby [[Kanaxai]], after his death. Each player in the party can open the chest once and will receive the following items.

==Location==
*[[The Jade Sea]]
**[[The Deep]]

==Kanaxai's Chest drops==
''Drop research is ongoing, and may be found [[Kanaxai's Chest/Research|here]].''

*Three [[Jadeite Shard]]s (6 Jadeite Shards in [[Hard mode]]) 

*One [[Demonic Summoning Stone]]

*One [[Passage Scroll to the Deep]] (Hard Mode only)

*One of the following (two in Hard mode): 
**A [[Item rarity|rare]] [[inscribable]] item, which may be one of the following items that are only available from this chest or [[Urgoz's Chest]]:
***[[Ceremonial Spear]]
***[[Crab Claw Maul]]
***[[Draconic Scythe]]
***[[Pronged Fan]]
***[[Serpentine Scepter]]
**A [[unique item]] unique to this chest:
***[[Kanaxai's Edge]]
***[[Kanaxai's Mallet]]
***[[Kanaxai's Axe]]

== Notes ==
*This chest was added in the [[Game_updates/20070524|24 May 2007 update]].
